crossRefs.note: He shall bring the bull to the door of the Tent of Meeting before Yahweh; and he shall lay his hand on the head of the…
He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill the sin offering in the place of burnt offering.

translations.web: He shall lay his hand on the head of the sin offering, and kill it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
translations.bsb: And he is to lay his hand on the head of the sin offering and slaughter it as a sin offering at the place where the burnt offering is slaughtered.
translations.kjv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin offering, and slay it for a sin offering in the place where they kill the burnt offering.
translations.asv: And he shall lay his hand upon the head of the sin-offering, and kill it for a sin-offering in the place where they kill the burnt-offering.
